notes: SPOTLIGHT SOLO v2 DRAGBACK = the ENCORE ending (shot 10, the owner's choice (B): the drag-back past the seated keeper, GOAL stamped by drop beams, result goal). No.10 side view facing east, right-footed (the near/right leg plays the ball). Not mirrored (no west strip; the sleeve "10" reads facing east). Registration = the v1 SoleLift canvas: contact = the LEFT (far) toe-tip column x 70 on turf row 102 on all six frames (as SoleLift F1-F6: on DB1-DB4 the toe tip itself is drawn at (70-71, 98-101) above the cleat line; on DB4b/DB4c the heel is up and the tip sits on row 102), so pinning the canvas once keeps the planted foot still. ball = the 12 px ball guide (turf ball centre on row 96), never drawn, ballUnder; boot = the touching surface (bootPart: DB1-DB2 the sole on the ball, DB3-DB4 the inside of the end-on boot); bootCentre (DB4) = the swung-through boot; knee (DB3) = the near knee over the end-on boot; toeNear / toeFar / heelNear / heelFar = the feet; heel (DB4b/DB4c) = the near heel landed on row 102; handNear / handFar = open palm centres (handFanNear / handFanFar = with the fingers); shoulder = the near shoulder joint; head = skull point; eye = the eye pixel (on the keeper DB1-DB2, then the net). Points are pixel indices (studioAnim adds 0.5; contact lands on the bottom edge of row 102). Shot 10 (shot-local, 150 BPM, g 16.4-18.0): DB1 0.00 (the crowd's 4th stomp), DB2 0.15, DB3 0.30, DB4 0.40 (beat 3: the touch, hit-stop, the ball rolling past the keeper) - 0.70, DB4b 0.70-0.95 (the net bellies 0.80; G / O / A / L stamped 0.80 / 0.90 / 1.00 / 1.10), DB4c 0.95-1.20 then the FREEZE from 1.20 under GOAL and the name card. DB4 is the shot-10 pulse Chorus source. Studio: Sochetra / DragBack / Side, layer Art (Front/Back blank).
